projects.title: DevMind
projects.shortDescription: AI assistant to help developers manage their projects
projects.longDescription: An AI-powered project management tool designed to streamline workflows for developers. By leveraging AI, DevMind automatically generates, documents, and prioritizes tasks, providing accurate time estimates based on individual skills, historical task data, and project priorities. The goal is to reduce manual planning, improve productivity, and ensure cohesive roadmap execution for solo developers.
